judged_text: `ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`, which executes an uncached `SELECT ... WHERE lower(host) = ?` query on every request, replacing the previous in-memory cached site-setting comparison. Forums with heavy embedding traffic gain one database round-trip per embedded pageview on /embed/comments and /embed/count — a path that previously cost zero queries — and `lower(host) = ?` cannot use a plain index on host (the new migration creates none), so the lookup is always a sequential scan; under embed-traffic spikes this adds measurable database load.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), and `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` performs `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb), which is a DB query per invocation. The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), and the query wraps the column in `lower(host)`, so a plain index (even if later added) wouldn’t be used without a functional index. This is a concrete performance/architecture regression compared to the previous in-memory `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` check, but not a correctness bug per se.
